title: Remove '(wolfCrypt code in preceding line)' from error messages
description:
Error messages in crypto2dev_fd.c were updated to include the phrase '(wolfCrypt code in preceding line)' inline in format strings. This phrase appears in log output and is problematic for three reasons:

1. It clutters user-facing and support logs with implementation-specific details
2. It's only meaningful to engineers with source code access
3. It's inaccurate for non-wolfCrypt providers (e.g., kcapi AEAD)

The phrase should either be:
- Removed entirely (preferred—the error code is sufficient)
- Moved to a code comment above the pr_err_ratelimited() call (preserves intent without polluting logs)

Affected lines in src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c:
- Line ~438: write() update failed
- Line ~856: set_iv() returned
- Line ~1131: sign() returned
- Line ~1137: verify() returned  
- Line ~1143: agree() returned
- Line ~1163: finalize() failed

The existing codebase establishes clean error messages without parenthetical runtime notes. Restore consistency with that pattern.
close_reason: Fixed: removed '(wolfCrypt code in preceding line)' from 6 pr_err_ratelimited format strings in crypto2dev_fd.c
